items.quote: - [x] **LIVE-01**: The console build is served to a browser from the same origin as the §18 REST app (or through a dev proxy), started by the launcher bound to 127.0.0.1 with a chosen store root, workspace and model clients;

- [x] **LIVE-02**: The Query & Compare screen calls the live POST /query, POST /query/stream and POST /compare instead of fixtures: streaming uses fetch with a ReadableStream SSE parser that checks status and content

- [x] **LIVE-03**: Live server errors render through the GUI-06 error states: a real refusal 422 shows the typed banner for its refusal_type, a real validation 422 shows field errors on the offending input,

- [x] **LIVE-04**: The Evidence & Trace screen calls the live POST /evidence/resolve with the EvidenceRef copied unchanged from the envelope, caches results per (namespace, ref) for the session so a second Open issues no request,

- [x] **LIVE-05**: The Documents & Jobs screen calls the live POST /documents, POST /documents/upload, GET /jobs/{job_id} and DELETE /documents/{document_id}; the returned job_id is stored in the client-side job list;

- [x] **LIVE-06**: The Corpus & Health screen calls the live GET /health, GET /corpus and GET /corpus/counts; health polls at the configured 30-60 s interval only when enabled and never while a query, compare, ingest or delete is in flight;

- [x] **LIVE-07**: The Ledger screen calls the live POST /promote, POST /rollback and POST /retire with alias, trace ids and change_origin from the form; a successful promote appends to the client-side ledger log and a follow-up POST /query with {alias} confirms it;

- [x] **LIVE-08**: The Graph/vector browser calls the live POST /graph/nodes, POST /graph/node and POST /chunks with a selector (never a namespace), pages by next_offset, and renders the store-busy refusal returned while another call holds the graph lock.

- [x] **LIVE-09**: In the connected build, an element keeps data-needs-backend and its badge exactly when its route is absent from the live app's /openapi.json, and loses both once the route is present and wired;
